title: The Big Lie About Nuclear Waste
summary: Cleo Abram's explainer on whether nuclear waste is really the intractable problem it is portrayed as, looking at how spent fuel can be recycled and used. It features a collaboration with Johnny Harris.
why: HN cites it in nuclear power debates for the point that recycling waste is largely a solved problem, though costly to build.

quote.text: recycling nuclear waste is kind of a solved problem
